subject: K8s service-account key rotation plan, evidence & ETA
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: K8s service-account key exposure — rotation plan & ETA

Team,

Quick update after the pen test call this morning: the tester found that a handful of long-lived Kubernetes service-account tokens used by the ingestion pipeline were present in an older backup snapshot. No active compromise detected, but Plethora Health (our customer) asked for an action plan and artifacts within 48 hours.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Rotate affected SA tokens and revoke old tokens in affected clusters.
- Regenerate secrets and push to k8s via sealed-secrets; mark old secrets as archived.
- Provide an audit-log extract showing token expiry events and the rotation operations.
- Deliver a short attestation and screenshots showing token state before/after.

Can you confirm ownership and ETA? I can coordinate the external handoff.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: K8s service-account key exposure — rotation plan & ETA

Thanks Grace — taking this as owner for the rotation work. Short plan and immediate ETA: 

Plan (actions I'll execute / delegate):
1) Identify exact SA names from the tester's report (doing now).
2) Schedule rolling rotation job across dev/stage/prod (non-disruptive) — target window: 2026-05-11 23:00 - 03:00 PT.
3) Re-issue secrets via sealed-secrets controller; mark old secrets with tag "rotated-20260511".
4) Revoke old tokens in KMS and update K8s RBAC binder entries where needed.
5) Collect audit logs and screenshots, package into evidence bundle.

ETA: I will have rotation complete and an evidence bundle ready for internal review by 2026-05-12 15:00 PT. I will attach the rotation playbook and the audit-log extract to the next message.

Cc-ing Karthik and Irene for approvals and SOC2 evidence mapping.

- Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior SRE, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sa-rotation-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook with step-by-step commands and rollback notes)

From: Maya Singh <security@plethorahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: K8s service-account key exposure — rotation plan & ETA

Thanks for the quick response. A few asks from our side so we can close the risk on our SOC inventory: 
- Can you provide the audit-log extract showing the creation/rotation timestamps and the cluster names? CSV is fine.
- We need a short attestation signed by your security lead that tokens were rotated and old tokens revoked.
- If possible, a short note describing the root cause (why the SA tokens ended up in that backup) and steps to prevent recurrence.

We appreciate the planned ETA. Please let us know if you hit any blockers.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Security Engineering
Plethora Health
security@plethorahealth.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: K8s service-account key exposure — rotation plan & ETA

Folks — quick internal QA and evidence notes before we hand to Plethora: 
- I reviewed the rotation playbook and executed a dry-run in the staging cluster. Commands and expected outputs are documented in sa-rotation-playbook-v1.pdf.
- Attached audit-log-extract-20260511.csv contains: cluster, namespace, sa_name, operation, timestamp, operator (rotated-by). I redacted internal operator IDs and kept only role names per our evidence-sharing policy.
- Root cause summary: legacy backup job included a plaintext copy of secrets stored in a pre-sealed-secrets archive. We have removed that job and added a policy to enforce sealed-secrets-only backups; note captured in the playbook.
- Attestation: Grace, can you provide a short one-paragraph attestation on your letterhead? I can append my QA signoff and then Mateo can send to Plethora.

I'll also generate a minimal runbook to prevent recurrence (cron check + backup whitelist). ETA for the final internal QA bundle: 2026-05-12 15:00 PT.

Irene Choi
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: audit-log-extract-20260511.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <security@plethorahealth.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: K8s service-account key exposure — rotation plan & ETA

Maya — forwarding final evidence bundle from Redwood.

Summary of deliverables attached:
- sa-rotation-playbook-v1.pdf (steps executed, rollback guidance)
- audit-log-extract-20260511.csv (rotation events, redacted operator roles)
- rotation-approval-screenshot.png (KMS console showing revoked keys)
- Small root-cause note: legacy backup job causing secret snapshot.

We have completed rotation across all affected clusters and revoked the old tokens. We will follow up with a formal attestation on company letterhead by EOD. If you need cryptographic proof (signed artifact), let us know and we can generate a signed hash of the evidence bundle.

Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4281

Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rotation-approval-screenshot.png
